mechanism: Meclizine may mask or worsen gastrointestinal side effects of amoxicillin (nausea, vomiting) due to its anticholinergic properties, potentially delaying recognition of amoxicillin-related GI adverse effects.
action: Monitor for adequate amoxicillin efficacy and GI tolerability; use meclizine cautiously if amoxicillin-induced nausea requires antiemetic management, and consider alternative antiemetics if possible.
